title: Keep the current intermediate merge queue
question: Does in-place replacement of the winning heap slot save verified 8 GiB Run time at the same fan-in?
summary: The two paired effects are 5.459 seconds saved and 4.308 seconds added, a 0.576-second median saving. The reversed pair ends the screen.

workloads: 8 GiB standalone Uniform, 256 MiB, one worker, ordinary snapshot and 64-way fan-in.

validation.summary: Four exact field/ID/export and cleanup checks pass. Storage and multiway collision controls pass. Managed traffic and hierarchy match.

limitations: Two pairs on WSL Linux with uncontrolled host cache.
exclusions: Native Windows, browser and smaller workloads.
reopen_when: Reopen for a different merge-cost hypothesis with an independently timed benefit.
